```yaml
name: Community PR Permissions Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if PR author has write permissions
        id: check-permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const prNumber = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            const author = context.payload.pull_request.user.login;

            try {
              // Check if the author has write permissions to the repository
              const { data: permission } = await github.rest.repos.getCollaboratorPermissionLevel({
                owner,
                repo,
                username: author
              });

              if (permission.permission === 'admin' || permission.permission === 'write') {
                console.log(`Author ${author} has write permissions`);
                return true;
              } else {
                console.log(`Author ${author} does not have write permissions`);
                return false;
              }
            } catch (error) {
              console.log(`Error checking permissions: ${error.message}`);
              return false;
            }

      - name: Fail if author doesn't have write permissions
        if: steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "Error: Pull request author does not have write permissions to the repository."
          exit 1

      - name: Check for required files in PR
        id: check-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          files: |
            airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/**
            docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat.md
            docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat-migrations.md

      - name: Validate required files are modified
        if: steps.check-files.outputs.all_changed_files_count < 1
        run: |
          echo "Error: No changes detected in required files for Zendesk Chat connector."
          exit 1

      - name: Validate manifest.yaml changes
        if: steps.check-files.outputs.all_changed_files_count >= 1
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES="${{ steps.check-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}"
          MANIFEST_CHANGED=false
          
          echo "Checking for manifest.yaml changes..."
          if [[ "$CHANGED_FILES" == *"manifest.yaml"* ]]; then
            MANIFEST_CHANGED=true
            echo "manifest.yaml has been modified"
          fi
          
          if [[ "$MANIFEST_CHANGED" == "false" ]]; then
            echo "Error: manifest.yaml must be modified for this change."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate metadata.yaml changes
        if: steps.check-files.outputs.all_changed_files_count >= 1
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES="${{ steps.check-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}"
          METADATA_CHANGED=false
          
          echo "Checking for metadata.yaml changes..."
          if [[ "$CHANGED_FILES" == *"metadata.yaml"* ]]; then
            METADATA_CHANGED=true
            echo "metadata.yaml has been modified"
          fi
          
          if [[ "$METADATA_CHANGED" == "false" ]]; then
            echo "Error: metadata.yaml must be modified for this change."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate documentation changes
        if: steps.check-files.outputs.all_changed_files_count >= 1
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES="${{ steps.check-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}"
          DOCS_CHANGED=false
          
          echo "Checking for documentation changes..."
          if [[ "$CHANGED_FILES" == *"zendesk-chat.md"* ]] || [[ "$CHANGED_FILES" == *"zendesk-chat-migrations.md"* ]]; then
            DOCS_CHANGED=true
            echo "Documentation files have been modified"
          fi
          
          if [[ "$DOCS_CHANGED" == "false" ]]; then
            echo "Warning: Documentation files should be updated for this change."
          fi

      - name: Validate version bump
        run: |
          # Check if version was bumped from 1.2.20 to 1.2.21
          echo "Checking version bump in metadata.yaml..."
          if ! grep -q "version: 1.2.21" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/metadata.yaml; then
            echo "Error: Version not correctly bumped to 1.2.21 in metadata.yaml"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Version bump validated"

      - name: Validate 404 response filter configuration
        run: |
          # Check that 404 filters were added to the manifest
          echo "Validating 404 response filters in manifest.yaml..."
          
          # Check chats stream
          if ! grep -A 4 -B 1 "status_code: 404" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml | grep -q "action: IGNORE"; then
            echo "Error: 404 response filter not found for chats stream"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check agent_timeline stream  
          if ! grep -A 4 -B 1 "status_code: 404" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml | grep -q "action: IGNORE"; then
            echo "Error: 404 response filter not found for agent_timeline stream"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "404 response filters validated"

      - name: Validate changelog entry
        run: |
          # Check that changelog entry was added to documentation
          echo "Checking changelog entry in zendesk-chat.md..."
          if ! grep -q "Handle 404 errors for deleted records" docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat.md; then
            echo "Warning: Changelog entry for 404 error handling not found in documentation"
          fi
          echo "Changelog validation completed"

      - name: Validate header formatting
        run: |
          # Check that header formatting is correct in migrations doc
          echo "Checking header formatting in zendesk-chat-migrations.md..."
          if ! grep -q "^#.*Migration" docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat-migrations.md; then
            echo "Warning: Header formatting may need correction in migrations document"
          fi
          echo "Header formatting validation completed"
```
